title: Global Inequalities in Weather Forecasts
abstract: Weather forecasts provide substantial economic value for society, but differences in forecast accuracy across regions can potentially exacerbate existing—and create new—economic inequalities. These differences are particularly important given the role of weather forecasts in helping prevent damage from climate change. In this paper, we provide a global analysis of the accuracy of predictions of temperature and relate our findings to existing economic inequalities. We report two stylized facts: First, temperature forecasts are much more accurate in high-income countries compared to low-income countries. A seven-day-ahead forecast in a high-income country is, on average, approximately as accurate as a one-day-ahead forecast in a low-income country. Second, while forecast accuracy has improved steadily since 1985, a persistent gap remains between high- and low-income countries. These disparities result both from differences in the inherent scientific challenge of weather predictability across regions and from unequal weather observing infrastructure. Countries with lower income have fewer land-based weather stations and radiosondes as well as lower reporting rates from existing infrastructure. Low-income countries also appear to have lower institutional capacity to issue official, local weather forecasts. Remedying the differences in monitoring infrastructure could help reduce the gap in forecast accuracy between higher-income and lower-income countries.
abstract_zh: 天气预报为社会提供了巨大的经济价值，但各地区之间预报准确性的差异，可能加剧现有的经济不平等，并产生新的不平等。鉴于天气预报在帮助防范气候变化损害方面的作用，这些差异尤为重要。本文对全球温度预测的准确性进行了全球范围的分析，并将我们的发现与现有的经济不平等联系起来。我们报告了两个典型事实：第一，高收入国家的温度预报比低收入国家准确得多。在高收入国家，提前七天的预报平均而言大致相当于低收入国家提前一天的预报准确度。第二，尽管自1985年以来预报准确度稳步提高，但高收入国家与低收入国家之间的差距依然存在。这些差异既源于各地区天气可预测性固有的科学难度不同，也源于天气观测基础设施的不平等。收入较低的国家拥有的陆基气象站和探空仪较少，现有基础设施的报告率也较低。低收入国家发布官方本地天气预报的制度能力似乎也较弱。纠正监测基础设施的差距，有助于缩小高收入国家与低收入国家之间的预报准确度差距。

title: Occupation and Temperature-Related Mortality in Mexico
abstract: We investigate how occupation influences temperature-related mortality in Mexico. Using decades of nationwide death and weather data, we find that temperature-related mortality risk varies sharply by occupation. Young adults in climate-exposed jobs experience significantly higher heat risk: a 15-24-year-old agricultural worker is over 10 × more likely to die from heat than an age-group peer in professional/managerial employment. Cold temperatures also increase mortality, especially for older non-workers. Our results suggest that occupational safety and adaptation policies may protect vulnerable workers from death and that ongoing economic shifts away from exposed sectors may moderate future heat-related mortality.
abstract_zh: 本文研究职业如何影响墨西哥与温度相关的死亡率。利用数十年的全国死亡与气象数据，我们发现与温度相关的死亡风险因职业而存在显著差异。从事气候暴露型工作的年轻成年人面临明显更高的高温风险：15至24岁的农业工人因高温死亡的可能性是同年龄段从事专业及管理类工作者的10倍以上。低温同样会提高死亡率，对非工作的老年人尤为明显。我们的结果表明，职业安全与适应政策可以保护弱势工人免于死亡，而经济结构从暴露型部门的持续转移可能会缓和未来与高温相关的死亡人数。

title: Weather Forecasts Become More Important for Reducing Mortality as the Climate Warms
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Climate change will increase the frequency and severity of extreme heat, which is a leading cause of weather-related mortality. We combine causal estimates of how temperature forecast accuracy affects mortality in the United States with expert projections of changes in forecast accuracy over the coming century. Our analysis shows that improving short-run temperature forecasts in line with central expert projections would reduce annual heat-related mortality by about 18% by 2100, saving thousands of lives per year. If investments in earth observation networks and weather models improve forecasts in line with optimistic expert projections, annual heat-related mortality would fall by around 25% by 2100. Improving forecasts facilitates adaptation to climate change, saving more lives when climate change is more severe.
abstract_zh: 气候变化将增加极端高温的频率与强度，而极端高温是与天气相关死亡的主要原因之一。我们将美国温度预报准确性如何影响死亡率的因果估计，与专家对未来一个世纪预报准确性变化的预测相结合。分析表明，若短期温度预报的改进符合专家的中位预测，到2100年每年与高温相关的死亡人数将减少约18%，每年可挽救数千条生命。若对地球观测网络和天气模型的投资使预报改进达到乐观专家预测的水平，到2100年每年与高温相关的死亡人数将减少约25%。改进预报有助于适应气候变化，且气候变化越严重，挽救的生命也越多。

title: Navigating the 'Problem from Hell': A Guide to Climate Damages
abstract: Multiple lines of research aim to quantify the economic impacts of climate change. We show that the effects of climate change on economic activity depend on how climate change alters weather across time and space. Changes in contemporary weather have direct effects on output; changes in past weather and in expectations of future weather induce adaptation; and changes in weather elsewhere around the globe introduce a general equilibrium effect. Using this framework, we argue that estimation of climate impacts faces a trilemma. A methodology can have at most two of: (i) robustness to a particular economic model’s structure, (ii) interpretation as effects of persistent, widespread, anticipated climate change, and (iii) quasi-experimental identification. We summarize the literature on climate damages in light of the trilemma. A solid body of knowledge has developed around direct effects, and recent work has made substantial progress towards understanding adaptation and spatial spillovers. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 多条研究路线旨在量化气候变化的经济影响。我们表明，气候变化对经济活动的影响取决于其如何在时间和空间上改变天气。当前天气的变化对产出有直接影响；过去天气的变化以及对未来天气的预期会引发适应行为；全球其他地区天气的变化则带来一般均衡效应。基于这一框架，我们认为气候影响的估计面临一个三难困境：一种方法至多只能同时满足以下三项中的两项：(i) 对特定经济模型结构的稳健性，(ii) 可解释为持续、广泛且可预期的气候变化的效应，以及(iii) 准实验识别。我们依据这一三难困境梳理了气候损害的文献。围绕直接效应已形成扎实的知识体系，近期研究在理解适应行为与空间溢出效应方面也取得了实质进展。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅用户以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Costs of Climate Adaptation: Evidence From French Agriculture
abstract: Climate policy requires credible estimates of the costs of adaptation, yet such estimates are scarce. Combining a panel of French farms with realized and forecasted weather, we use forecasts as information shocks to identify the costs and benefits of anticipatory responses to heat. In the year heat occurs, forecasts cause inexpensive responses that generate large benefits, because they reduce the likelihood of harmful under-preparation. Costs arrive later, eventually offsetting these gains. Projected to 2100, adapting to climate change would cost 27% of average profit. Finally, existing estimators in the literature would overstate direct damages of heat and static costs.
abstract_zh: 气候政策需要可信的适应成本估计，然而此类估计十分稀缺。我们结合法国农场面板数据与实际及预报的天气信息，将预报作为信息冲击，以识别对高温进行预期性应对的成本与收益。在高温发生当年，预报引发的应对措施成本低廉却收益可观，因为它们降低了准备不足带来损害的可能性。成本则在之后显现，并最终抵消这些收益。预计到2100年，适应气候变化的成本将占平均利润的27%。最后，文献中现有的估计方法会高估高温的直接损害及静态成本。

title: What's in a Mane? Appearance Norms and Racialized Hair Bias
abstract: We use an incentive-compatible survey experiment to investigate a malleable identity marker that individuals alter to conform to dominant norms at recurring private cost: hair. Subjects rate headshots of hypothetical job candidates on professionalism, competence, and agreeableness. Relative to straightened hair, wearing one's naturally curly or kinky hair texture carries larger penalties for Black women than for White women across all metrics. Smiling partially attenuates these penalties. For Black men, racialized penalties are concentrated on agreeableness. Our findings inform ongoing legal discourse around recognizing hair texture as a protected racial characteristic and outlawing hair-based discrimination in the U.S.

title: Heat Disproportionately Kills Young People: Evidence From Wet-Bulb Temperature in Mexico
abstract: Recent studies project that temperature-related mortality will be the largest source of damage from climate change, with particular concern for the elderly whom it is believed bear the largest heat-related mortality risk. We study heat and mortality in Mexico, a country that exhibits a unique combination of universal mortality microdata and among the most extreme levels of humid heat. Combining detailed measurements of wet-bulb temperature with age-specific mortality data, we find that younger people are particularly vulnerable to heat: People under 35 years old account for 75% of recent heat-related deaths and 87% of heat-related lost life years, while those 50 and older account for 96% of cold-related deaths and 80% of cold-related lost life years. We develop high-resolution projections of humid heat and associated mortality and find that under the end-of-century SSP 3–7.0 emissions scenario, temperature-related deaths shift from older to younger people. Deaths among under-35-year-olds increase 32% while decreasing by 33% among other age groups.
abstract_zh: 近期研究预测，与温度相关的死亡将是气候变化造成损害的最大来源，并认为老年人承受的高温死亡风险最大，因而尤其值得关注。我们研究墨西哥的高温与死亡问题，该国兼具全民覆盖的死亡微观数据，以及极端湿热水平居于世界前列的独特条件。通过将湿球温度的精细测量与分年龄死亡数据相结合，我们发现年轻人尤其容易受到高温影响：35岁以下人群占近期与高温相关死亡的75%，占与高温相关的损失寿命年数的87%；而50岁及以上人群占与低温相关死亡的96%，占与低温相关损失寿命年数的80%。我们构建了湿热及相关死亡的高分辨率预测，发现在本世纪末SSP 3–7.0排放情景下，与温度相关的死亡会由老年人转向年轻人。35岁以下人群的死亡人数将增加32%，而其他年龄段的死亡人数将减少33%。

title: Competition Constrains Climate Adaptation
abstract: How does market structure affect climate adaptation decisions? To answer this question, we combine detailed weather data, financial records from small vendors working for Ghana’s largest mobile money provider, and exogenous variation in market competition. Unexpected increases in temperature decrease sales revenue, seller labor supply, and the number of customers. Accurate forecasts reduce adverse effects on revenue by 50%, highlighting the value of forecast information for adaptation. However, adaptation is lower in more competitive markets due to coordination failures. Our results point to an unintended negative effect of policies designed to increase competition in retail markets.
abstract_zh: 市场结构如何影响气候适应决策？为回答这一问题，我们结合了详细的天气数据、为加纳最大移动货币服务商工作的小型商贩的财务记录，以及市场竞争的外生变动。气温的意外升高会降低销售收入、卖家的劳动供给以及顾客数量。准确的预报可将不利影响对收入的冲击减少50%，凸显了预报信息对适应的价值。然而，由于协调失灵，竞争更激烈的市场中适应程度更低。我们的结果指出，旨在提高零售市场竞争程度的政策可能带来未预期的负面效应。

title: The Freezing Point of History: Extreme Temperatures Hinder Elite Emergence
abstract: Adverse environmental shocks impair children's average health and development, but effects across the outcome distribution remain under-explored. Studying American birth cohorts from 1790--1960, we show that a harsh winter during the birth year reduces both the likelihood of achieving high income later in life and the emergence of historically notable political and cultural leaders. Inflows of lower-quality leaders from nearby states and cohorts partially offset the effects. Stronger effects in low intergenerational mobility states, where history-makers are less likely to have elite parents, indicate that well-off families are insulated from weather shocks. Our results imply a potential poverty trap: hardships obstruct the rise of leaders who might have driven long-term growth and progress.
abstract_zh: 不利的环境冲击会损害儿童的平均健康与发展，但其在结果分布上的影响仍未得到充分探讨。利用1790至1960年间美国出生队列的数据，我们发现出生当年的严冬既降低了其日后获得高收入的可能性，也减少了具有历史声望的政治与文化领袖的涌现。来自邻近州及队列的较低质量领袖的流入，部分抵消了这些影响。在代际流动性较低的州，这些效应更为强烈，因为史上的名人较少出身于精英家庭，这表明富裕家庭能够抵御天气冲击。我们的结果暗示存在潜在的贫困陷阱：困苦阻碍了那些本可推动长期增长与进步的领袖的崛起。

title: Adjusting to Rain Before It Falls
abstract:
Unchecked climate change will cause precipitation volatility to increase around the world, leading to economic damages in the face of adjustment costs. We estimate these damages for construction—an economically important, climate exposed industry. Empirically, employment falls in response to forecasted rainfall and more so as the forecast horizon increases. This pattern allows for identification of labor adjustment costs via a multisector model of local labor markets calibrated to our estimates. When rainfall is anticipatable one month ahead, construction firms pay 10% of monthly profit to adjust. They pay less than 1% for rainfall anticipatable six months ahead. Without further adaptation or forecast improvements, increased rainfall volatility due to climate change is projected to lead to more costly adjustment.
This paper was accepted by Elke Weber, Special Section of Management Science on Business and Climate Change.
Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4697 .
abstract_zh:
若不加控制，气候变化将导致全球降水波动加剧，并在调整成本之下造成经济损失。我们以建筑业为对象估计这些损失，该行业在经济上十分重要且高度暴露于气候风险。实证上，就业会随预报降雨量下降，且预报期限越长，下降幅度越大。这一模式使我们能够借助一个根据估计结果校准的、描述地方劳动力市场的多部门模型，识别劳动力调整成本。当降雨可提前一个月预期时，建筑企业需支付月利润的10%用于调整；而对于可提前六个月预期的降雨，其支付则不足1%。若不进一步适应或改进预报，气候变化导致的降雨波动加剧预计将带来更高的调整成本。
本文由Elke Weber录用，刊于《管理科学》（Management Science）“商业与气候变化”专题。
补充材料：数据文件及在线附录可在 https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4697 获取。

title: Improving Climate Damage Estimates by Accounting for Adaptation
venue: Revision requested, American Economic Journal: Economic Policy
abstract: Climate change is projected to severely damage the global economy. Adaptation in response to the changing climate will affect how much damage ultimately occurs. An important source of uncertainty in existing damage estimates is the extent to which they include or exclude such adaptation. This paper shows how to identify damages by estimating economic responses to climate shocks while controlling for weather forecasts. The resulting empirical strategy also provides estimates of the benefits from forward-looking adaptation. The strategy is applied to study damages from climate shocks and adaptation benefits using detailed, firm-level data on commercial fishing and a novel dataset of climate forecasts. Without accounting for adaptation, direct damage estimates are substantially biased. Adaptation also yields large benefits, with forecasts allowing firms to time entry into the fishery to best avoid adverse conditions.
abstract_zh: 预计气候变化将严重损害全球经济。气候变化下的适应行为将影响最终造成的损害程度。现有损害估计中一个重要的不确定性来源，在于其是否纳入了此类适应行为。本文展示了如何在控制天气预报的同时，通过估计经济主体对气候冲击的反应来识别损害。由此形成的实证策略还能估计前瞻性适应的收益。我们利用商业捕捞业的详细企业层面数据及一套新的气候预报数据集，应用该策略研究气候冲击的损害与适应收益。若不考虑适应行为，直接损害的估计会存在显著偏误。适应也带来可观收益，预报使企业能够选择进入渔业的时机，从而最大程度地避开不利条件。

title: Why Do We Procrastinate? Present Bias and Optimism
venue: Revision requested; IZA Discussion Paper No. 13060
abstract: Procrastination has significant adverse effects on individuals, including lower savings and poorer health. Such behavior is typically modeled as resulting from present bias, a form of preference non-stationarity. In this paper, we study an alternative: excessively optimistic beliefs about future costs or demands on an individual's time. The models can be distinguished by how individuals respond to cost-relevant information. Experimental results refute the hypothesis that non-stationarity is the sole source of dynamic inconsistency, but they are consistent with biased beliefs about shocks. These findings offer an explanation for low takeup of commitment and suggest that personalized information can mitigate procrastination.

title: Choose Your Moments: Peer Review and Scientific Risk Taking
abstract: Science funding agencies are often criticized for being too conservative. One explanation is that agencies typically base decisions on a simple average of peer review scores. Using a discrete choice experiment conducted with a large sample of biomedical researchers, we find that scientists prefer to fund projects with more reviewer dissensus. In contrast to funding allocation rules that focus primarily on the first moment of the distribution of reviewer scores, they also value the second moment. Scientists with the greatest domain expertise are particularly enthusiastic about dissensus. Using scientists’ preferences changes funding decisions for projects worth billions of dollars annually.

title: Fatal Errors: The Mortality Value of Accurate Weather Forecasts
abstract: We provide the first revealed preference estimates of the benefits of routine weather forecasts. The benefits come from how people use advance information to reduce mortality from heat and cold. Theoretically, more accurate forecasts reduce mortality if and only if mortality risk is convex in forecast errors. We test for such convexity using data on the universe of mortality events and weather forecasts for a twelve-year period in the U.S. Results show that erroneously mild forecasts increase mortality whereas erroneously extreme forecasts do not reduce mortality. Making forecasts 50% more accurate would save 2,200 lives per year. The public would be willing to pay $112 billion to make forecasts 50% more accurate over the remainder of the century, of which $22 billion reflects how forecasts facilitate adaptation to climate change.
abstract_zh: 我们首次给出了日常天气预报收益的显示偏好估计。这些收益源于人们如何利用事先信息来减少高温与低温导致的死亡。理论上，当且仅当死亡风险是预报误差的凸函数时，更准确的预报才能减少死亡。我们利用美国十二年间全部死亡事件与天气预报的数据检验了这种凸性。结果显示，错误地预报偏温和会增加死亡，而错误地预报偏极端则不会减少死亡。将预报准确性提高50%每年可挽救2,200条生命。公众愿意为在本世纪剩余时间内将预报准确性提高50%支付1,120亿美元，其中220亿美元反映的是预报对适应气候变化的促进作用。

title: Mandatory Disclosure Is Key to Address Climate Risks
abstract: Investors have known about climate change for decades. Yet it is only recently that several countries—including France, Japan, New Zealand, and the United Kingdom—have developed policies requiring large public companies to regularly disclose information about climate-related financial risks. In March 2022, the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) proposed a climate disclosure rule that, distinctively, would affect all firms publicly traded in the United States regardless of their size or country of incorporation. With the policy’s broad scope, the large size and exceptional liquidity of the US financial market, and the SEC’s influence on securities regulations worldwide, this presents a major opportunity to standardize the way that public firms measure, report, and address climate risks. As the SEC digests a substantial number of public comments on their draft rule ahead of a planned October release of the final rule, we discuss their rationale and consider implications and opportunities for research and policy.
abstract_zh: 投资者对气候变化已有数十年的认识。然而，直到最近，法国、日本、新西兰和英国等数个国家才出台政策，要求大型上市公司定期披露与气候相关的财务风险信息。2022年3月，美国证券交易委员会（SEC）提出了一项气候信息披露规则，其独特之处在于无论企业规模大小或注册地在何处，都将适用于所有在美国上市的公司。鉴于该政策的广泛覆盖面、美国金融市场的巨大规模与卓越流动性，以及SEC对全球证券监管的影响力，这为统一上市公司衡量、报告和应对气候风险的方式提供了重大机遇。在SEC于计划于十月发布最终规则之前消化大量针对征求意见稿的公众意见之际，我们讨论了其理据，并探讨了其对研究与政策的影响及机遇。

title: The Risk of Caution: Evidence from an Experiment
abstract: Innovation is important for firm performance and broader economic growth. But breakthrough innovations necessarily require greater risk-taking than more incremental approaches. To understand how managers respond to uncertainty when making research and development decisions, we conducted experiments with master’s degree students in a program focused on the intersection of business and technology. Study participants were asked to choose whether to fund hypothetical research projects using a process that mirrors real-world research and development funding decisions. The experiments provided financial rewards that disproportionately encouraged the choice of higher-risk projects. Despite these incentives, most participants chose lower-risk projects at the expense of projects more likely to generate a large payoff. Heterogeneity analysis and additional experimental treatments show that individual risk preferences predict greater tolerance of high-risk projects and suggest that more appropriate decision making can be learned. Thus, for firms seeking to fund breakthrough R&D, appropriate screening and training of employees may play important roles in increasing the likelihood of success.

title: (Not So) Clean Peak Energy Standards
abstract: The emissions impact of operating an energy storage system depends on the system’s efficiency and the generation mix of the grid. Growth in energy storage, therefore, has the potential to increase emissions. Concerns about this outcome are currently prompting many policies to address the issue. We study a particularly popular policy proposal called the “Clean Peak Standard” that incentivizes storage to discharge during periods of high electricity demand. The stated goal of the policy is to shift storage discharge so that it offsets production from peak generators with high emissions. We show that the policy is largely ineffective at achieving this emissions reduction goal. The policy reinforces existing incentives faced by storage operators, so it does not have a strong effect on discharging behavior. It is also unable to capture high-frequency changes in marginal operating emissions rates. Alternative policies, such as a carbon tax, are more effective at reducing the emissions increase caused by storage operations. Policymakers considering Clean Peak-style policies should instead consider these alternative policies.
abstract_zh: 运行储能系统的排放影响取决于该系统的效率以及电网的发电结构。因此，储能的增长有可能增加排放。对此类后果的担忧，目前促使许多政策着手解决这一问题。我们研究了一项颇受欢迎的政策提案，即“清洁高峰标准”（Clean Peak Standard），该标准激励储能在电力需求高峰时段放电。该政策的既定目标是调整储能放电时间，使其抵消高排放高峰发电机组的发电量。我们表明，该政策在实现这一减排目标方面基本无效。该政策强化了储能运营商已有的激励，因此对放电行为的影响不大。它也无法捕捉边际运行排放率的高频变化。相比之下，碳税等替代政策在减少储能运行所引起的排放增长方面更为有效。考虑采用类似清洁高峰标准政策的决策者，应转而考虑这些替代政策。

title: Revealing Future Abatement Costs from Permit Banking Behavior
Assessing the Rationale for the U.S. EPA’s Proposed "Strengthening Transparency in Regulatory Science" Rule
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy 14(1): 131-135
abstract: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) is considering a new policy that would prohibit the agency from issuing regulations that rely on studies whose underlying data are not publicly available. While the EPA claims it is pursuing this policy in the interest of transparency, we argue that such a prohibition would greatly hinder, rather than help, the rulemaking process and would likely result in undesirable regulatory outcomes that fail to maximize economic welfare. This policy brief argues that a good faith effort to encourage data availability should focus on forward-looking incentives for transparency rather than the exclusion of a whole class of studies, and that weighting older studies based on their evidentiary value is preferable to removing valuable information from agency consideration.
abstract_zh: 美国环境保护署（EPA）正在考虑一项新政策，该政策将禁止该机构发布依赖于原始数据不公开的研究的法规。尽管EPA称此举旨在提高透明度，但我们认为这一禁令将严重阻碍而非促进规制过程，并可能导致无法实现经济福利最大化的不良监管结果。本政策简报认为，要真诚地鼓励数据开放，应着眼于激励透明度的前瞻性机制，而非排除整类研究；同时，根据其证据价值对较早的研究进行加权，比将有价值的信息从机构考量中剔除更为可取。

title: Time Use and Labor Productivity: The Returns to Sleep
abstract: We investigate how the largest use of time—sleep—affects productivity. Time use data from the United States allow us to test a model in which sleep improves productivity. Consistent with theory, we find sleep is more complementary to home production than to leisure for nonemployed individuals. We then show that later sunset time reduces worker sleep and earnings. After ruling out alternative hypotheses, we implement an instrumental variables specification that provides causal estimates of the impact of sleep on earnings. A 1-hour increase in location-average weekly sleep increases earnings by 1.1% in the short run and 5% in the long run.

title: Translating the Terrestrial Mitigation Hierarchy to Marine Megafauna Bycatch
abstract: In terrestrial and coastal systems, the mitigation hierarchy is widely and increasingly used to guide actions to ensure that no net loss of biodiversity ensues from development. We develop a conceptual model which applies this approach to the mitigation of marine megafauna by‐catch in fisheries, going from defining an overarching goal with an associated quantitative target, through avoidance, minimization, remediation to offsetting. We demonstrate the framework's utility as a tool for structuring thinking and exposing uncertainties. We draw comparisons between debates ongoing in terrestrial situations and in by‐catch mitigation, to show how insights from each could inform the other; these are the hierarchical nature of mitigation, out‐of‐kind offsets, research as an offset, incentivizing implementation of mitigation measures, societal limits and uncertainty. We explore how economic incentives could be used throughout the hierarchy to improve the achievement of by‐catch goals. We conclude by highlighting the importance of clear agreed goals, of thinking beyond single species and individual jurisdictions to account for complex interactions and policy leakage, of taking uncertainty explicitly into account and of thinking creatively about approaches to by‐catch mitigation in order to improve outcomes for conservation and fishers. We suggest that the framework set out here could be helpful in supporting efforts to improve by‐catch mitigation efforts and highlight the need for a full empirical application to substantiate this.
abstract_zh: 在陆地与沿海系统中，缓解层级（mitigation hierarchy）被广泛且日益频繁地用于指导行动，以确保开发活动不致造成生物多样性的净损失。我们构建了一个概念模型，将这一方法应用于渔业中海洋大型动物兼捕（by-catch）的缓解，其步骤包括：确定带有相应量化目标的总体目标，然后依次进行避免、最小化、修复和抵消。我们展示了该框架作为一种工具的效用，它有助于梳理思路并揭示不确定性。我们将陆地情境中正在进行的争论与兼捕缓解进行比较，以说明两者的见解如何相互借鉴，这些见解包括：缓解的层级性质、异类抵消（out-of-kind offsets）、以研究作为抵消、激励缓解措施的实施、社会限度与不确定性。我们探讨了如何在整个层级中运用经济激励，以更好地实现兼捕目标。最后，我们强调：明确并达成共识的目标十分重要；需要超越单一物种与单一管辖区来考虑复杂的相互作用与政策泄漏；需要明确纳入不确定性；并且需要创造性地思考兼捕缓解的方法，以改善保护与渔民的结果。我们认为，本文提出的框架有助于支持改善兼捕缓解工作的努力，同时强调需要进行完整的实证应用以加以证实。

title: Forecasting in the Presence of Expectations
venue: The European Physical Journal: Special Topics 225(3): 539-550
abstract: Physical processes routinely influence economic outcomes, and actions by economic agents can, in turn, influence physical processes. This feedback creates challenges for forecasting and inference, creating the potential for complementarity between models from different academic disciplines. Using the example of prediction of water availability during a drought, we illustrate the potential biases in forecasts that only take part of a coupled system into account. In particular, we show that forecasts can alter the feedbacks between supply and demand, leading to inaccurate prediction about future states of the system. Although the example is specific to drought, the problem of feedback between expectations and forecast quality is not isolated to the particular model–it is relevant to areas as diverse as population assessments for conservation, balancing the electrical grid, and setting macroeconomic policy.
abstract_zh: 物理过程经常影响经济结果，而经济主体的行为反过来也会影响物理过程。这种反馈给预测与推断带来挑战，也为不同学科的模型之间实现互补创造了可能。以干旱期间的水资源可获得性预测为例，我们说明了仅考虑耦合系统一部分的预测可能存在的偏误。特别地，我们表明预报可能改变供给与需求之间的反馈关系，从而导致对系统未来状态的不准确预测。尽管该例子针对的是干旱，但预期与预报质量之间的反馈问题并非某一特定模型所独有，它同样与保护领域的种群评估、电网平衡以及宏观经济政策制定等诸多领域相关。

title: Temperature Extremes, Health, and Human Capital
abstract: The extreme temperatures expected under climate change may be especially harmful to children. Children are more vulnerable to heat partly because of their physiological features, but, perhaps more important, because they behave and respond differently than adults do. Children are less likely to manage their own heat risk and may have fewer ways to avoid heat; for example, because they don’t plan their own schedules, they typically can’t avoid activity during hot portions of the day. And very young children may not be able to tell adults that they’re feeling heat’s effects.
abstract_zh: 气候变化下预计出现的极端温度对儿童可能尤为有害。儿童更易受高温影响，部分原因在于其生理特征，但更重要的原因在于，他们的行为方式与应对方式不同于成年人。儿童较难管理自身的高温风险，且可用于躲避高温的方式也较少；例如，由于他们不自行安排日程，通常无法避开一天中炎热的时段进行活动。而且，非常年幼的儿童可能无法向成年人表达其感受到高温影响。

title: Discount Window Stigma During the 2007-2008 Financial Crisis
abstract: We provide empirical evidence for the existence, magnitude, and economic cost of stigma associated with banks borrowing from the Federal Reserve's Discount Window (DW) during the 2007–2008 financial crisis. We find that banks were willing to pay a premium of around 44 basis points (bps) across funding sources (126 bps after the bankruptcy of Lehman Brothers) to avoid borrowing from the DW. DW stigma is economically relevant as it increased some banks' borrowing cost by 32 bps of their pre-tax return on assets (ROA) during the crisis. The implications of our results for the provision of liquidity by central banks are discussed.

title: Financial Amplification Mechanisms and the Federal Reserve's Supply of Liquidity During the Financial Crisis
abstract: This paper investigates how losses on subprime mortgage assets during the financial crisis of approximately $300 billion led to rapid and deep declines in the value of a wide range of other financial assets and real economic output. The disproportionate amount of total losses compared with the relatively small size of the initial trigger points to the presence of amplification mechanisms that allowed losses centered in one market to cause a systemwide downturn. The study focuses on two financial amplification mechanisms of relevance to the crisis: balance-sheet amplifiers and adverse-selection amplifiers.
